The '''MM-XT Mini-Missile Tube''' was a single-shot compact [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launcher]] produced by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 700 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was designed for small vehicles, such as [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bikes]], [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]] or [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]].<ref name="DC" />
